value.rationale: A natural all-cardinality enumerator of inclusion-maximal dissociation sets is determined for an infinite two-parameter line-graph family. The global side-occupation criterion yields exact labelled multiplicities and a sharp infinite n>=2m regime whose attainable maximal-set cardinalities have gaps of parity two. This is not recovered by the known scalar maximum or merely by counting all unconstrained star components.
